feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 26 September 2026 11:19am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 26 September 2026 at 11:20am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Flat ridge of high pressure covers the Irish Sea. Slow-moving area of low pressure near Iceland.


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, backing south or southwest 5 or 6 this evening, then south or southeast overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate this evening.


##Weather##

Fair, rain spreading from the west later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southeast 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 for a time tomorrow afternoon. Then veering west by late afternoon, and then gradually decreasing west or southwest 3 or 4 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Rain at first, becoming mainly fair later tomorrow afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain at first.
